programme.title: SuperDad
programme.desc: "Xu Wei Hao (Thomas Ong) and Li Zheng Yi (Jeremy Chan) are neighbours who share one thing in common, both men are looked down upon by their wives and children. They receive a mysterious box of chocolates one day, thinking it was a mistake by the post office, Wei Hao and Zheng Yi each took a piece of the chocolate. Zheng Yi, once a cowardly policeman, suddenly possesses superb ability in solving a crime. While Wei Hao regains the respect of his daughter by saving her when she fell from a building. Chen Kai (Chen Han Wei), the ex-husband of Zheng Yi’s wife, was released from jail and tries to seek forgiveness. Seeing his sincerity in turning over a new leaf, Zheng Yi took him in. He accidentally took a piece of the chocolate and discovers its super power. The trio starts to rely on the chocolate every time they needed its super power to solve problems, making them the Super Dad in their children’s eyes. One day, the three fathers see their own children in danger, but there is only one piece of chocolate left. Will they fight to see who gets the last piece of chocolate or will they count on their own will to save their children?"

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.desc: Heldorado is an annual parade celebrating Las Vegas as a frontier town. Roy is captain of the guards at Boulder Dam. He helps celebrate the town's anniversary while capturing racketeers involved with the local casinos.

programme.title: Westward Bound
programme.desc: Learning that Montana is about to become a state and that property values will rise rapidly, Caldwell is using his outlaw gang to force the ranchers off their land. To fight back Tuttle sends for the Trail Blazers and unaware of Maynard's identity, Caldwell appoints him Marshal.

programme.title: Without Honors (1932) Colorized
programme.desc: “In Without Honors, cowboy star Richard Arlen rides into a frontier tangled in treachery and deceit. Framed for a crime he didn’t commit, he must fight to clear his name and expose the outlaws behind the scheme. With tense drama, blazing action, and a touch of romance, this early Western delivers a rugged tale of courage and justice won the hard way.

programme.title: The Gabby Hayes Show - Jump'in Jack
programme.desc: Dramatizing the lives of historical figures, such as the naval commander, the lawman and professional gambler, and the outlaw Belle, tall tales and Western scenes

programme.title: Django the Avenger 1969
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger appears to be on a mission of revenge

programme.title: The Feud of the Trail
programme.desc: A man who's a dead ringer for the leader of an outlaw gang kills the gang leader, then takes his place to try to bring the gang to justice.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: U.S. marshal John Carruthers observes a robbery and Sheriff Jake thinks he may be the culprit. Meanwhile the town's leading citizen is planning to rob everybody blind.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: A man framed for murder escapes prison and goes west, where he joins a gang with the real killer involved.

programme.title: The Law of 45's 1935
programme.desc: In The Law of 45’s, Western star Guinn ‘Big Boy’ Williams blazes onto the screen as Tucson Smith, one of the famed Three Mesquiteers. When land-grabbing crooks terrorize ranchers, Tucson and his partner Stony Brooke (Al St. John) saddle up to take a stand. With blazing six-guns, quick-draw justice, and plenty of frontier grit, this action-packed adventure marks the beginning of the legendary Mesquiteers series.

programme.title: Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Four of the West's most infamous outlaws carry out a daring bank heist in the gold-rush town, Bath Water. As the posse takes chase, things take a turn for the worse, as the bandits realize they've been double-crossed - but by who?

programme.title: Between God, The Devil, And A Winchester
programme.desc: A man gains access to a treasure map and persuades a guide (Juan Chasquisdo) to accompany him in his search to recover it. Both are pursued by bandits.

programme.title: The Gabby Hayes Show - Telescope
programme.desc: Dramatizing the lives of historical figures, such as the naval commander, the lawman and professional gambler, and the outlaw Belle, tall tales and Western scenes

programme.title: Son of the Renegade 1953
programme.desc: In Son of the Renegade, cowboy star Johnny Carpenter saddles up for a tale of legacy and justice. As the son of a notorious outlaw, he fights to escape the shadow of his father’s crimes and prove himself a man of honor. With outlaws closing in and the law on his trail, he takes a stand to defend the innocent and clear his name. Packed with gun-slinging action, high-stakes drama, and frontier grit, this Western asks—can the son of a renegade carve out a destiny of his own?

programme.title: Dirty Outlaws
programme.desc: An outlaw masquerades as the son of a blind man in order to find a cache of gold located in a vacated town

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: A rookie in the police force must engage in a cat-and-mouse game with a pistol-wielding psychopath who becomes obsessed with her.

programme.title: Branded a Coward
programme.desc: Johnny Hume witnesses the slaughter of his family at age six. When he grows into manhood, will he be able to seek his vengeance?

programme.title: Code Of The Cactus 1939
programme.desc: In Code of the Cactus, cowboy hero Tim McCoy rides into action when a greedy gang plots to seize control of the stagecoach line. With fast-draw courage and sharp wits, he takes on the outlaws to protect the frontier’s lifeline. Filled with hard-riding action, shootouts, and frontier justice, this thrilling Western proves the West was won by men who lived by a code as tough as the cactus itself.

programme.title: Roll On Texas Moon 1946
programme.desc: Roy Rogers rides tall in Roll On Texas Moon, a Western packed with action, music, and romance. When a bitter feud erupts between cattlemen and sheep ranchers, Roy steps in to prevent bloodshed and uncover the schemers fueling the conflict. With Dale Evans, George ‘Gabby’ Hayes, and the Sons of the Pioneers along for the ride, the film blends fast-paced adventure, trail songs, and Texas charm into a classic Roy Rogers showdown.

programme.title: cp_071_his_girl_friday
programme.desc: When a newspaper editor's ace reporter ex-wife is about to quit her job and remarry, he buys himself time to win her back by promising her an exclusive interview with a death row convict.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: In Tulsa, after a rancher dies during a feud with a major oil company, his daughter, driven by revenge, starts digging for oil herself.

programme.title: The Terror : Starring Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A young French soldier cut off from his unit is beguiled by a mysterious woman, whom he learns is the wife of the local Baron - and that she seemingly died twenty years earlier

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: The first film adaptation of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic novel about a land where prehistoric creatures still roam.

programme.title: The Vampire Bat
programme.desc: When corpses drained of blood begin to show up in a European village, vampirism is suspected to be responsible.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson must protect a Swiss inventor of an advanced bomb sight from falling into German hands.

programme.title: The Mad Monster
programme.desc: A mad scientist changes his simple-minded handyman into a werewolf in order to prove his supposedly crazy scientific theories - and exact revenge.

programme.title: The Woman In Green
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes investigates when young women around London turn up murdered, each with a finger severed. Scotland Yard suspects a madman, but Holmes believes the killings to be part of a diabolical plot.

programme.title: Commandos
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian-American commando outfit disguised as an Italian Army unit is parachuted behind Axis lines in North Africa.

programme.title: The Black Connection
programme.desc: Las Vegas drug dealer is in deep with the Italian mob over a large amount of missing cocaine. He must get creative to get out from under the mob before they take the ultimate course of action.

programme.title: Dr Black and Mr Hyde
programme.desc: When a Black doctor develops a serum that is supposed to regenerate dying liver cells and tests it on himself, it accidentally turns him into an albino monster with a lust for murdering prostitutes, pimps and drug dealers.

programme.title: The Black Street Fighter
programme.desc: To make money, a Los Angeles street-fighter goes to work for gangsters.

programme.title: High Kicks
programme.desc: Toughs are troubling Sandy and her new aerobics studio; with the help of new employee Sam (a karate expert), she shows them who is boss.

programme.title: The Guy From Harlem
programme.desc: A private detective operating in Miami is hired to protect the wife of an African head of state in town for diplomatic business, and to recover the daughter of the leader of a criminal organization, who has been kidnapped by a rival gang.

programme.title: Look_Out_Sister_1947
programme.desc: A famous bandleader, suffering from overwork and exhaustion, goes to a sanitarium for a rest. While there he dreams of being out west at a dude ranch, where he finds himself involved in the beautiful owner's struggle to keep her ranch from falling into the hands of the villain, who wants either her or her ranch (or, preferably, both).

programme.title: Fox Style
programme.desc: A wealthy nightclub owner struggles to reconcile his country upbringing with his city environs

programme.title: Albino
programme.desc: A colonial police officer in Rhodesia hunts down the albino terrorist who raped and murdered his fiancée.

programme.title: Brothers
programme.desc: Thinly disguised account of the relationship between radical black activist Angela Davis and Black Panther and prison inmate George Jackson, who was killed in a failed 1971 prison breakout.

programme.title: The Legend Of Black Charley
programme.desc: A slave kills a white man in self-defense and heads West towards freedom, pursued by a professional slave hunter.

programme.title: Slavers
programme.desc: As the slave trade is dwindling in East Africa in the late 19th century, two competing slave traders start a brutal violent conflict between each other for the monopoly on the remaining profits.

programme.title: High Kicks
programme.desc: Toughs are troubling Sandy and her new aerobics studio; with the help of new employee Sam (a karate expert), she shows them who is boss.

programme.title: Date With The Angels - S1E03: High Fever
programme.desc: Vickie insists that Gus receive medical treatment when he comes down with a low-grade temperature, but the only doctor she is able to locate is a wisecracking obstetrician.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Japanese spymaster Prince Daka operates a covert espionage organization located in Gotham City's now-deserted Little Tokyo which turns American scientists into pliable zombies.

programme.title: Frontier Doctor - S1E09: Fury of the Big Top
programme.desc: Dr.Baxtor treats a mysterious little girl found half-dead in the desert, rendered mute by the trauma she's face. However, not everything is as it seems.

programme.title: Bonanza - S1E24: The Stranger
programme.desc: Inspector Leduque comes from New Orleans to Virginia City to take Ben Cartwright back for a 20 year murder. When Ben declares publicly that he is withdrawing from the Governor's race, the townsfolk are upset not just about this but Little Joe has also been accused of gunning down Leduque's deputy in cold blood.

programme.title: Date With The Angels - S2E03: Everybody's Baby
programme.desc: The Time: 5 months after Vickie and Gus were married. The Main Character: One Stork. The Plot: Rock-a-Bye Boo Boo. The Angel's good friend is having a baby and everybody's at the hospital.

programme.title: Date With The Angels - S1E05: A Tree in the Parkway
programme.desc: Vickie gets the neighbors to sign a petition to stop the city from removing a tree from the parkway.

programme.title: Dusty's Trail - S1E03: Horse of Another Color
programme.desc: Dusty finds a stray horse and tames it, only to be arrested as a horse thief by a vigilante crew who wants to hang him in the morning.

programme.title: Custer
programme.desc: In 1868, after the Civil War, Custer takes charge of a mix of ex-Confederates and criminals, the 7th Cavalry Regiment at Fort Hays, Kansas. His boss General Terry doesn't like his methods or his long blond hair, but he manages to keep fighting the Sioux (the series ends the year before the Little Big Horn)

programme.title: Frontier Doctor - S1E05: The Apache Uprising
programme.desc: Dr. Baxter tries to bring peace between the Apaches and the local town folks. A hot-headed deputy sheriff complicate the situation.

programme.title: Bonanza - S1E26: The Avenger
programme.desc: Ben and Adam are locked in jail, about to hung for a crime they didn't commit. Joe and Hoss must find out why the witnesses to the alleged crime have perjured themselves before the execution takes place. They receive help from an unexpected source, a drifter called Lassiter who is searching for the men who committed a lynching in Kansas years ago.

programme.title: Frontier Doctor - S1E06: Double Boomerang
programme.desc: A series of cave-ins at a gold mine leads to a confrontation between the mine owner and Dr.Baxter.

programme.title: Frontier Doctor - S1E08: The Outlaw Legion
programme.desc: Lured to a remote cabin, Dr. Baxter discovers the men he's treating for bullet wounds are members of Butch Cassidy's "Hole in the Wall Gang".

programme.title: Date With The Angels - S1E07: Shall we Dance?
programme.desc: The Time: 8 months after Vickie and Gus were married. The Community Boys Club is having a Modern Dance fund raiser, and Vickie and Gus get roped in to do an interpretive dance.

programme.title: Life With Elizabeth - S1E04: 1. Ping Pong 2. Leaky Roof 3. Vacuum Salesman

programme.title: Date With The Angels - S1E09: The Blue Tie

programme.title: The Phantom Cowboy
programme.desc: Bill Collins meets up with his look-alike the Phantom and is soon involved in his fight with Buck Houston. Houston has a big robbery planned but the Phantom beats him to it.

programme.title: Blazing Justice
programme.desc: A cowboy captures two rustlers and collects a $5000 reward. Using the money to take a vacation, he winds up getting accused of a murder he didn't commit.

programme.title: Lightning Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Lightning Carson's nephew has been falsely accused of murder. To get in with the gang, Lightning poses as a Mexican. He also appears as himself making his costume changes at his sister's ranch. Just as he about to bring in the gang, a henchman finds evidence of his masquerade and arrives to expose the hoax.

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

programme.title: Bells Of San Fernando
programme.desc: In the Spanish-rule days of Old California, a San Fernando girl, Maria Garcia, falls in love with an Irish immigrant, Michael O'Brien, (which is why Donald Woods and not Duncan Renaldo plays the role.

programme.title: The Grand Duel
programme.desc: A grizzled ex-sheriff helps a man framed for murder to confront the powerful trio of brothers who want him dead.

programme.title: Boss Cowboy
programme.desc: Both Nolan and Ross are losing cattle and Ross' foreman Kerns is the culprit. When Taylor finds a wanted poster of Kerns he goes after him.

programme.title: The Great Adventure
programme.desc: Set during the American Gold Rush era, this is an unforgettable tale of an orphaned boy and his wild dog who must battle against the Yukon wilderness and human greed to help save a frontier town.

programme.title: Inn of the Damned
programme.desc: A sheriff investigates why the guests at a local hostelry check in, but never check out.

programme.title: The Fighting Fist Of Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: A Chinese immigrant, recently arrived in America, fights to free Mexican slaves from their cruel master.

programme.title: Border Patrol

programme.title: Shadows of Death
programme.desc: With the railroad coming to Red Rock, trouble is expected and Billy has been sent to help his friend Fuzzy who is the town's sheriff, judge, and barber.

programme.title: The Trackers

programme.title: Son of the Renegade
programme.desc: Red River Johnny gathers his friends (most of whom are called some variation of the name Bill) and returns to claim the heritage of his father who was outlawed many years ago by the sheriff of Red River.

programme.title: The Wyoming Whirlwind
programme.desc: A mysterious bandit known only as “The Wolf” is terrorizing a local ranch. Is the outlaw really up to no good, or is he trying to avenge some long-ago wrong?

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: The farcical, footloose misadventures of Trinity and Sartana as a pair of sharp-shooting Robin Hood-style con artists that repeatedly thwart the villains but never get to keep the loot for themselves.

programme.title: Creekside Cigar Co.

programme.title: Privada Cigar Club

programme.title: Burn Rate

programme.title: Unrolled

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.desc: Join host Sean Mobley as he sits down with the esteemed cigar maker, Chantel Leavitt, offering unique insights into the meticulous art of blending and the dedication required to craft exceptional cigars. Discover the inspiration behind Bella Dama's signature creations and gain a deeper appreciation for the nuances that define a truly remarkable smoke.

programme.title: Privada Cigar Club

programme.title: Reinventarse como mujer, mamá y artista: Jessi León en Momento de Desmadre Podcast
programme.desc: En este episodio de Momento de Desmadre, hablamos con la cantautora argentina @TheJessileon León, mitad del dúo Periko & Jessi León, sobre cómo la maternidad transformó su vida y su música. Jessi nos cuenta cómo ella y Periko decidieron reinventarse completamente tras convertirse en padres. Junto a su hijo Milo, están lanzando un nuevo disco @pjkidsOfficial una recopilación de canciones inéditas para niños, grabadas desde su casa, en familia y con mucho amor. Hablamos de cómo la maternidad no solo nos cambia, sino que nos abre la mente para crear cosas absolutamente maravillosas. Desde los desafíos emocionales hasta los momentos de inspiración profunda, este episodio es un testimonio de resiliencia, amor y creatividad. No olvides suscribirte, dejar tu comentario y compartir este video con esa mamá, artista o persona creativa que necesita escucharlo. #MomentoDeDesmadre #JessiLeón #PerikoyJessiLeón #MaternidadCreativa #DiscoInfantil #Reinvención #PodcastEnEspañol #MúsicaDesdeCasa #MamáArtista

programme.title: ¿Las pantallas están criando a tus hijos? Sol Macaluso y Fátima de Francisco en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc: uevo programa de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro — y esta vez tocamos uno de los temas más urgentes: cómo las pantallas, las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial están afectando a la infancia. Las invitadas de lujo fueron:

programme.title: “Lactancia: el poder que nos negaron | Matronas al Rescate”
programme.desc: En la Semana Europea de la Lactancia, las matronas levantan la voz. Gema y su equipo reciben a Arantxa Sánchez, matrona y experta IBCLC, para hablar sin filtros de todo lo que rodea al pecho, al sueño y al postparto.

programme.title: Ángela Cremonte le da un zasca a los gobernantes en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc: Nueva entrega de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro. Hoy nos visita Ángela Cremonte, actriz española, que nos abrió su corazón para hablar de su parto, postparto y la realidad de la maternidad. Pero lo más fuerte fueron los zascas al gobierno, denunciando la invisibilización de las madres y la falta de apoyo real. Un testimonio valiente y necesario. Además: Emma Salado recordó el parto de Gema Clavero, al que asistió, compartiendo fotos inéditas y anécdotas divertidas. Gema nos sorprendió otra vez hablando de la vida sexual de su amiga… sin pelos en la lengua. Y en la sección de noticias: llegan los condones de colores que detectan enfermedades de transmisión sexual. Sí, lo has leído bien. Un programón que mezcla ciencia, maternidad real y mucho humor.

programme.title: Jonatan Armengol padre, ciego y activista: historia real, emociones y perros guía
programme.desc: En este episodio de "Matronas al Rescate" con Emma Salado y Gema Clavero, contamos con la participación de Jonatan Armengol, influencer, crítico gastronómico, activista por la accesibilidad y padre que vive su paternidad siendo ciego. Jonatan se emocionó al ver los videos del programa: desde el primer saludo de la matrona en el parto, el momento de su mujer dando a luz, hasta pequeños gestos cotidianos como cambiar a su bebé. También, al médico que permitió que su perro guía, *Calo*, entrara en la habitación hospitalaria, algo muy simbólico para él. Hablamos de todo: cómo son sus ojos, las críticas que recibe, los retos de grabar con Ray-Ban todo lo que le pasa, su viralidad defendiendo los derechos del perro guía (como el episodio del taxi en el que no lo dejaron entrar), y cómo responde ante quienes minimizan su vida o la de Calo. Además, pusimos sobre la mesa discusiones más amplias: la frase polémica de Trump sobre paracetamol y autismo, el bebé de 7 kilos (sí, el más grande que conocen) y los **Premios con Alma** de Celia Padilla.

programme.title: Gloria de la Torre: su historia como madre de acogida, el hate y su embarazo en Matronas al rescate
programme.desc: n este episodio de Matronas al rescate, Emma Salado y Gema Clavero charlan con Gloria G de la Torre, más conocida como Mami de acogida. Gloria abre su corazón y cuenta cómo vivió la maternidad de acogida con dos niñas que después regresaron con su familia biológica, y cómo finalmente llegó a la maternidad biológica con su propio embarazo. Además, habla de su vida como influencer, del hate en redes sociales y de todo lo que aprendió en un camino lleno de emociones, despedidas y nuevos comienzos.

programme.title: EMMA SALADO, GEMA Y CRISTINA PAREJO HABLAN DE SEXO Y MATERNIDAD EN EL BARRO I MATRONAS AL RESCATE
programme.desc: Hablar de maternidad y sexo sigue siendo un tabú, pero en esta charla de BARRO lo rompemos sin miedo. ¿Qué pasa con el placer después del parto? ¿Cómo cambia el deseo, la intimidad y la forma de relacionarnos cuando nos convertimos en madres y padres? Entre risas, experiencias reales y preguntas incómodas, exploramos la relación entre parto, placer y sexualidad para abrir la conversación que tantos callan.
